sources.title: OME-NGFF 0.5 specification
sources.applicability: Named axes, physical units and ordered scale/translation vocabulary for the proposed frame model and derived-image interchange; does not establish arbitrary affine support.

sources.title: tifffile README: read and write TIFF files
sources.pin: README states tifffile 2026.9.20; master branch captured 2026-10-05; exact captured body hash is the source pin
sources.locator: Lines 7-36 supported families and array access; Notes lines 183-273, especially unimplemented TIFF features, NDPI, BIF and stitching; Examples lines 759-782 for Zarr region reads
sources.applicability: Primary current documentation for the positive and explicit negative support claims. Its format list is not treated as an exhaustive denylist; individual instrument files still need fixtures.

sources.title: tifffile CHANGES.rst release history

sources.applicability: Version/history context for changing reader capabilities, BIF stitching limits and the #319 release fix; not a runtime test.
